summary: A strong local and regional weekend led by the 24-hour mini-moto race at Tri-City Kart Club, an Evergreen MTB event at Raging River, the temporary car-free Sunrise Road opportunity at Mount Rainier, and the final Gorge concert of the season.

recommendations.title: 24-Hour Mini Moto Endurance Challenge
recommendations.description: A continuous mini-moto endurance race running through the night, with different track configurations planned.
recommendations.why: Rare, local, and directly aligned with your mini-moto/motorsports interests.

recommendations.title: Evo 25th Anniversary MTB Race
recommendations.description: Evergreen-linked anniversary event and race at Raging River, with new trail work tied to the celebration.
recommendations.why: A destination you already want to ride, with a one-time event layered on top.

recommendations.title: Car-Free Sunrise Road
recommendations.description: Sunrise Road is temporarily closed to normal vehicle traffic while remaining available to bicycles and pedestrians, subject to current NPS restrictions.
recommendations.why: Direct hit on your Rainier road-bike wishlist and a temporary access situation.

recommendations.title: John Summit — Experts Only
recommendations.description: A major electronic show and the final listed Gorge concert weekend of the 2026 season.
recommendations.why: Easy to combine with a ride or run earlier in the day.

recommendations.title: Dark Side / Shoulder-Season Forest MTB
recommendations.description: A longer forest ride becomes more attractive as temperatures cool, provided smoke and closure conditions cooperate.
recommendations.why: Good season for sustained forest riding without summer heat.

recommendations.title: Gifford Pinchot Wishlist Day
recommendations.description: Use an open route to advance a Boundary Trail, Strawberry Ridge, or other Gifford Pinchot moto objective.
recommendations.why: Moves a real wishlist item forward rather than defaulting to a generic forest-road loop.

recommendations.title: Joseph / Wallowas Fall Moto Weekend
recommendations.description: A fall-color dual-sport or road-moto weekend in northeast Oregon, with hiking or trail running added if desired.
recommendations.why: Familiar destination, but early October gives it a strong seasonal reason to return.

recommendations.title: Local Columbia Basin Gravel
recommendations.description: Build a 40–80 mile wheat-country gravel day around the best wind window.
recommendations.why: Low logistics and useful endurance volume.

recommendations.title: Badger / Candy Hill Repeats
recommendations.description: A local climbing workout using Badger or Candy Mountain for repeatable vert.
recommendations.why: Directly useful for your ultra build without consuming the whole day.

recommendations.title: Snyder Dock Waterski
recommendations.description: Pick the calmest dawn window if fall air and water temperatures still make it worthwhile.
recommendations.why: Easy local option if the water glasses off.

recommendations.title: Leavenworth Oktoberfest + Ride
recommendations.description: Pair Oktoberfest with MTB, gravel, or a scenic road ride rather than making the festival the whole trip.
recommendations.why: A worthwhile event layer on a destination that already works for cycling.

recommendations.title: Bend MTB Weekend
recommendations.description: Phil's, Wanoga, or other Bend-area trails in cool fall conditions.
recommendations.why: A proven destination that becomes especially good as temperatures drop.

recommendations.title: Oktober Feast 5K
recommendations.description: A simple local race option that can fit before a larger afternoon or evening plan.

recommendations.title: Tri-City Kart Club — Spectate the Endurance Race
recommendations.description: Drop in after another activity to watch the overnight endurance race without committing to racing.
recommendations.why: A rare local motorsports event that is easy to layer into the weekend.

recommendations.title: Ski / Snow — Not Yet
recommendations.description: No meaningful alpine or backcountry ski recommendation for this weekend yet.
recommendations.why: Keeps the category visible without inventing a weak recommendation.
